assessments.explanation: Two distinct APKs (org.example.service_a, org.example.service_b) contain strong static evidence (STRONG_STATIC_ASSOCIATION) associating the same UUID '0000180d-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb' with GATT service registration via BluetoothGattServer.addService(). This is a high-confidence static overlap and may warrant runtime/host-context validation. [Knowledge Base Provenance: 'Heart Rate Service' sourced from Bluetooth SIG Assigned Numbers (https://www.bluetooth.com/specifications/assigned-numbers/)]

knowledge_base_match.name: Heart Rate Service
knowledge_base_match.analyst_notes: Standard GATT Heart Rate Service (16-bit 0x180D) widely used by health, fitness wearables, and chest straps.

participating_apks.diagnosis: Verified intra-method registration: Literal UUID '0000180d-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb' loaded at offset 0x0000, converted via UUID.fromString at offset 0x0004, used in BluetoothGattService constructor at offset 0x0012, and registered via BluetoothGattServer.addService() at offset 0x0018.

Verified intra-method registration: Literal UUID '0000180d-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb' loaded at offset 0x0000, converted via UUID.fromString at offset 0x0004, used in BluetoothGattService constructor at offset 0x0012, and registered via BluetoothGattServer.addService() at offset 0x0018.

knowledge_base_metadata.provenance_policy: Strict provenance requirement: every identifier must be sourced from an official standards body (e.g., Bluetooth SIG), an operating system vendor (e.g., AOSP, Google), or a published hardware vendor technical specification. No unsourced or speculative entries are permitted.

methodology_and_limitations: Definition of Strong Duplicate Static Registration: An assessment is classified as STRONG_DUPLICATE_STATIC_REGISTRATION (with is_proven = true strictly according to UCSD's static-analysis evidence criteria) if and only if two or more distinct APK packages both demonstrate verified intra-method Dalvik register data-flow (STRONG_STATIC_ASSOCIATION) associating the identical GATT service UUID with BluetoothGattServer.addService(). Static analysis establishes high-confidence static overlap; it does NOT constitute proof of runtime vulnerability, confirmed host collision, or confirmed service squatting.

Duplicate Candidates are NOT Proven Conflicts: Identical UUID candidate strings appearing across multiple APKs (e.g. from shared third-party SDKs, utility libraries, or string pools) without verified dual static GATT registration are classified as DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE_NO_REGISTRATION. They are explicitly NOT presented as runtime service conflicts.

Non-Malicious Nature of Assigned Standards: Matching a Bluetooth SIG assigned UUID (e.g. Heart Rate, Battery Service) or known vendor identifier is a standard protocol implementation pattern. It does NOT indicate malicious intent or spoofing without operational device evidence.

No Unverifiable System/Vendor Claims: An identifier is classified as system-level or vendor-specific (KNOWN_SYSTEM_OR_VENDOR_MATCH) only when supported by verifiable source documentation in the versioned knowledge base.

Strict Absence of Calibrated Probabilities: Conflict determinations are discrete qualitative classifications based on verified static Dalvik bytecode evidence, not numeric risk scores or calibrated percentages.
Knowledge Base Scope and Currency: The UUID knowledge base contains curated identifiers with verifiable provenance. Unknown UUIDs remain strictly unknown (UNKNOWN_UNCONFLICTED).
